attempts.why: Turn 1 Prankster Taunt landed on Gothitelle before its Trick Room; Heat Wave OHKO'd Shiinotic (Beads of Ruin) and took Gothitelle to 192; Shiinotic had chosen Moonblast into the Grass-type Whimsicott, not Spore into Chi-Yu. Turn 2 Conkeldurr Protected (Flame Orb burn activated), Dark Pulse KO'd the Taunted Gothitelle. Turn 3 Mach Punch put Chi-Yu on its Sash, Moonblast OHKO'd the burned Conkeldurr, Overheat OHKO'd Mega Scovillain. Turn 4-5 Marowak Shadow Bone and Reuniclus Psychic KO'd Whimsicott (the one faint); Marowak Protected the Fake Out. Turn 6 Earth Power OHKO'd Marowak, Reuniclus Protected Knock Off, then Earth Power finished it.

turn 1 Shiinotic chose Moonblast into Whimsicott (Grass, Spore-immune) instead of Spore into Chi-Yu, the legal and far more dangerous target; it died before moving

Shadow Bone 186 to Whimsicott (turn 4), Psychic KO turn 5

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked Moonblast (~445 next turn, lethal) and banked the Flame Orb burn - good
blocked Fake Out - good read; partner Reuniclus KO'd Whimsicott
blocked a lethal Knock Off; partner Marowak died anyway; it fell next turn - delay only

ai_defects.board: Shiinotic 308/308 + Gothitelle vs Whimsicott (Grass/Fairy, Sash) + Chi-Yu (Dark/Fire, Sash)
ai_defects.better: Spore -> Chi-Yu (Whimsicott is powder-immune; Chi-Yu is the threat that OHKOs Shiinotic and the setter). The authored 'Spore puts a legal target to sleep with certainty' did not fire even though a legal target stood on the field.

ai_notes: Gothitelle's Trick Room intent on turn 1 was correct. Marowak's Protect against the Fake Out turn was a strong read.

level_changes.why: OHKO'd turn 1 by Heat Wave without acting
Taunted and KO'd turn 2 without ever setting the room

level_change_rationale: Brief step 5: first-try 6-1 with no real threat once the room was Taunted. The two setup pieces go +1; the Mega and the heavy mode keep their offsets.
cooler: The room-plus-trap identity is right and the trap is real (switch_blocked_by shows it). The weak point is that the whole plan is one Prankster Taunt from collapse and the AI does not Spore the legal target. A Mental Herb on Gothitelle instead of Shiinotic (Gothitelle is the piece that must not be Taunted; Shiinotic's Herb only protects a move the AI did not choose) would make the door far nastier at zero set cost. Recommend swapping the two held items in a later pass.
verification_limit: The +1 on Shiinotic and Gothitelle cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds.
